value.rationale: The invariant is a natural complete grading of ordered homogeneous one-point extensions and strictly refines the usual independent-set polynomial. The result identifies the first irrecoverable unordered graph structure, even for connected bases, shows the lost property is the number of four-cycles, and proves persistent information loss at all larger finite sizes by a structural twin-extension lemma. This is a motivated sharp reconstruction boundary plus an unbounded construction, not a routine small instance or a mere renaming.
